body:
I think that documenting it could be noisy because where you have the replay object, you have also the request itself and that `reply.request` is the same instance.

It is not clear to me the use case for `decorateReply`, could you argue more?

I understand now, thank you 👍
I change my mind: if it already used in other plugins we should document it and provide support for it.
There are also tests that cover that property.

Before I was meaing that a user, without checking the code, could add a decorator that accept the request as a parameter (for sure this solution is less elegant).
I'm not sure if is not documented on purpose or we just missed it. @mcollina do you recall something?
I think we should just document that at this point.
This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
